issue: css/campaign.css (campaign/shell owner), finding #8: at heights of 700 px or less, the equip screen's footer hint `.cp-eq > footer .scr-hint` is still cut with an ellipsis. Patch: in the @media (max-height: 700px) block, replace `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;` with `display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; white-space: normal;`.

css/campaign.css, finding #8: at 1024×560, `.cp-eq-left` (line-clamp 2) shows a cut-off third line because of its padding. Patch: add `max-height: calc(2.7em + 10px);` inside the same @media (max-height: 700px) rule, or collapse it to one line below 620 px with a «mais» toggle in campaign_ui.js.

js/sim/battle/actions.js (sim owner), finding #5 at the engine level: in `P.walk`, when a step has `s.occupant !== null && (s.door || s.opensUfoDoor !== null && s.opensUfoDoor !== undefined)`, it currently yields `interrupt 'blocked'` without opening the door. Proposed behaviour, as in the original game: open the door (`OV.Env.openDoor(B, u, s.door ? s.door.i : s.opensUfoDoor, s.door ? s.door.part : 3)`), charge TU_DOOR when `!a.free`, `yield* refreshSightings(B, OV.LOS.refreshAll(B))`, then `yield interrupt(B, u, 'spotted'); return { ok: false, reason: 'spotted', moved }`. The AI and headless bots would then behave the same way; the UI fallback (`doorBlock`) can stay.

Equipment UI owner (js/ui/inventory_ui.js, finding #4): AUTO-EQUIPAR takes the medikit away from whoever had it. In autoFor(s), before emptyInto(s.id), compute const hadMed = loTypes(E.loadouts[s.id]).indexOf('medikit') >= 0 and pass { keepMed: hadMed } into autoLoadout's options. In autoLoadout, change the medikit condition from (best && best.id === s.id && have('medikit') …) to ((opt.keepMed || (best && best.id === s.id)) && have('medikit') …). The soldier's own medikit goes back to stores in emptyInto, so it is available again.

Sim owner (js/sim/geo/missions.js onUfoLiftOff or js/sim/geo/world.js, finding #5): so the headless bot also stops chasing, after ufo.status = 'flying' in onUfoLiftOff, add a loop over G.crafts. For each craft c with c.dest && c.dest.kind === 'ufo' && c.dest.id === ufo.id, D().crafts[c.type].transport, (c.status === 'out' || c.status === 'patrol') and !c.dogfightId, call OV.World.recall(G, c.id), or set c.dest = 'home' and status 'returning' the same way recall does. The UI's transportsHome() then finds nothing left to do, so the two do not conflict.

SHELL/CAMPAIGN FIXER (js/ui/campaign_ui.js). In `autoKit`, replace `const guns = PREF_GUNS.concat(Object.keys(st).filter(...))` with `const guns = C().kitGuns ? C().kitGuns(G, st) : PREF_GUNS.concat(Object.keys(st).filter((id) => D().items[id] && D().items[id].kind === 'firearm' && PREF_GUNS.indexOf(id) < 0).sort((a, b) => weightOf(a) - weightOf(b)));`.
